node: Thermal management and power-conditioning components for high-density AI racks
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one obvious reference leader and three less-obvious US-listed component/system suppliers directly tied to AI-rack cooling or power conditioning. Vertiv is the high-attention context anchor. nVent and Modine are direct thermal/power infrastructure suppliers but now sit above the ideal USD 300M-10B hunt range, so they are included because exposure is unusually direct. Bel Fuse remains the cleaner small/mid-cap discovery candidate: it sells power, protection, connectivity, front-end power supplies and data-center/HPC/AI-related power products, but AI exposure must be verified through segment revenue, hyperscaler/server OEM qualification, order backlog, and margin mix. This is research universe expansion only, not a trading recommendation.
